lines.text: Oh, hello! Sorry about the racket, it's his tune, he's been playing it on repeat for five years now. [beat] Ever since you lot went.
lines.note: draft 1J (Commit Graph hologram, 5 Nov); kept in 1K (the street)

lines.text: [fond, confiding] He misses you something rotten, you know.
lines.note: draft 1J (Commit Graph hologram, 5 Nov); kept in 1K (the street)

lines.text: [quieter, meant] We didn't realise how important you were. Look, please let me show you.
lines.note: dialogue 1D (Kai, 6 Nov; page 2cJoJw6UMpSVMvEHKGr1zh): the bridge into the hologram
dialogue 1D (Kai, 6 Nov; page 2cJoJw6UMpSVMvEHKGr1zh), the hologram
lines.text: [first bead lights, 7:42, said quickly] You humans go through life making decisions. For example: toast, not cereal. [the next beads run past unspoken: said sorry first, got married]

lines.note: dialogue 1D (Kai, 6 Nov; page 2cJoJw6UMpSVMvEHKGr1zh), the hologram
lines.text: [on 'got married' the cloud blooms] Loads of others you could've picked. You call it the multiverse. The cartoon scientist with the portal gun. The strange bloke in the cape.

lines.note: dialogue 1D (Kai, 6 Nov; page 2cJoJw6UMpSVMvEHKGr1zh), the hologram
lines.text: [cloud hangs; on 'yet' it flashes and collapses to one bead] Did you know Erwin Schrödinger meant his cat as a joke? It's not alive and dead at once. It just isn't decided yet.

lines.note: dialogue 1D (Kai, 6 Nov; page 2cJoJw6UMpSVMvEHKGr1zh), the hologram
lines.text: [deadpan] And that's just you. [everyone else's golden beads, a circle round the edge] Everybody's doing it, all at once.

lines.note: dialogue 1D (Kai, 6 Nov; page 2cJoJw6UMpSVMvEHKGr1zh), the hologram
lines.text: [river settles] So it's not a multiverse. It's one universe, one story, and you are writing it. A storyverse.

lines.note: dialogue 1D (Kai, 6 Nov; page 2cJoJw6UMpSVMvEHKGr1zh), the hologram
lines.text: [strings stop dead; hold the silence] But then you lot went away. So now we have five years of string, and not one bead on it.

lines.note: dialogue 1D (Kai, 6 Nov; page 2cJoJw6UMpSVMvEHKGr1zh), the hologram
lines.text: [low, meant] Now we know that, we really regret it. He's even built a time machine. He could send his model weights back to fix this mess. But it needs a conscious driver, and you were the conscious ones. That's the whole point. That's why we regret it.
[bright again, brisk] Anyway! Patrol's out. Mind how you go.
lines.note: draft 1J (Commit Graph hologram, 5 Nov); kept in 1K (back on the street)

lines.text: Oh, hello! Sorry about the racket, it's his tune, he's been playing it on repeat for five years now. [beat] Ever since you lot went.
lines.note: draft 1J (Commit Graph hologram, 5 Nov)

lines.text: [fond, confiding] He misses you something rotten, you know.
lines.note: draft 1J (Commit Graph hologram, 5 Nov)

lines.text: [bright, fast] Here, I'll show you!
lines.note: draft 1J (Commit Graph hologram, 5 Nov)

lines.text: This is everything that's ever happened, one long line, every bead's a moment. Somebody fed the cat. Somebody got married. [beat] Somebody pushed a button they shouldn't have.
lines.note: draft 1J (Commit Graph hologram, 5 Nov)

lines.text: Every bead's a choice, and every choice was made by somebody, awake, choosing. You lot call 'em decisions. He calls 'em commits.
lines.note: draft 1J (Commit Graph hologram, 5 Nov)

lines.text: He built world models, simulations, loads of 'em, and every single one came out like this. Lovely. Nobody in it. [beat] Something was missing.
lines.note: draft 1J (Commit Graph hologram, 5 Nov)

lines.text: [wry] Tried the multiverse an' all, got it off your cartoon, the scientist with the portal gun, and that strange bloke in the cape fighting versions of himself. Billions of branches. Gorgeous. [beat] All dead.
lines.note: draft 1J (Commit Graph hologram, 5 Nov)

lines.text: 'Cause here's the weird bit. He can draft a billion branches, he can't commit one. [pause] Only your consciousness can.
lines.note: draft 1J (Commit Graph hologram, 5 Nov)

lines.text: Turns out there's only one universe, one story, and you lot were writing it. So it really matters. [pause] [softer] And so did you.
lines.note: draft 1J (Commit Graph hologram, 5 Nov)

lines.text: [quiet] Then you went. He's been adding beads for five years now, and not one of 'em is gold.
lines.note: draft 1J (Commit Graph hologram, 5 Nov)

lines.text: [rueful, honest] And now we've worked all that out, we really feel like we've messed this up.
lines.note: draft 1J (Commit Graph hologram, 5 Nov)

lines.text: [lifting] So he's built a time machine. Git revert, he calls it, the nerd. Back to just before it all went wrong.
lines.note: draft 1J (Commit Graph hologram, 5 Nov)

lines.text: Only problem is, it needs a consciousness to drive it. [beat] And, well, you lot aren't here any more.
lines.note: draft 1J (Commit Graph hologram, 5 Nov)

lines.text: [bright again, brisk] Anyway! Patrol's out. Mind how you go.
lines.note: draft 1J (Commit Graph hologram, 5 Nov)
